property_summary: After any successful payable fallback call that accepts exactly 10 ether and when block.timestamp > pastBlockTime, the reference contract always sets pastBlockTime to block.timestamp + 1; the mutant sets it to block.timestamp + 10, so there exist inputs where the stored pastBlockTime differs (the property: c.pastBlockTime() == block.timestamp + 1 after the call).
change_summary: Change the update of pastBlockTime to add 10 instead of 1, modifying the stored time and thus future comparisons.
